name: Ritaania no Seirei Tsukai -Meikyuu o Yuku Mono-
original_name: リターニアの精霊使い-迷宮を征く者-
source:
In the peaceful Kingdom of Retarnia, which has known no war for five centuries, tranquility is shattered as portals to the Demon World burst open, unleashing sinister monsters intent on conquest.

This crisis mirrors an event from five hundred years ago, when the "Spirit Master of Retarnia" and his five spirits—Norn the White Spirit, Vesta the Red Spirit, Rusalka the Blue Spirit, Melissa the Green Spirit, and Iris the Black Spirit—fought the demons and sealed these portals.

Now, at Queen Sylvia's behest, Leonard, a direct descendant of the original Spirit Master, embarks on a perilous journey into the Demon World to protect his kingdom from impending doom...

[Based on [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1042]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
在和平的雷塔尼亚王国，五个世纪以来没有经历过战争，随着通往恶魔世界的大门突然打开，释放出意图征服的邪恶怪物，宁静被打破了。

这场危机反映了五百年前的事件，当时“雷塔尼亚的精灵大师”和他的五位精灵——白精灵诺恩、红精灵维斯塔、蓝精灵露莎卡、绿精灵梅丽莎和黑精灵艾里斯——与恶魔战斗并封印了这些传送门。

现在，在西尔维娅女王的授意下，原魂师的直系后裔伦纳德踏上了进入恶魔世界的危险旅程，以保护他的王国免受即将到来的厄运……

[基于 [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1042]MangaGamer[/url]]
